Theremin
Electronic oscillators produce the sound; hand positions near antennas control pitch and volume without touching the instrument.
provenance: Name from Darius Kazemi and Corpora contributors, CC0: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dariusk/corpora/2e7adec11a0561696c236ae1fca82e88be173d42/data/music/instruments.json. Original sound-mechanism grouping, not a complete Hornbostel–Sachs code. Corrected saxaphone→saxophone and mellotran→Mellotron; omitted piano size duplicates. Mechanism descriptions are original factual framing.

Mellotron
A keyboard controls playback of sampled instrument sounds. Original Mellotrons use magnetic-tape strips; later digital models replay recorded samples electronically.
